chunks.heading: Lift
chunks.text:
## Lift
An elevator serving the building's floors — relevant mainly for apartments above the second or third floor.

chunks.heading: Power Backup
chunks.text:
## Power Backup
The building has a generator or inverter system that keeps essential power (lights, fans, sometimes AC) running during outages, which are still common in parts of Kerala during monsoon season.

chunks.heading: Security
chunks.text:
## Security
The property has a security guard, gated entry, or a monitored access system.

chunks.heading: Gym
chunks.text:
## Gym
An on-site fitness room, usually shared among residents of an apartment complex or gated community.

chunks.heading: Swimming Pool
chunks.text:
## Swimming Pool
A shared pool within the property complex, common in villas and larger gated apartment communities, less common in standalone apartments or PGs.

chunks.heading: Children Play Area
chunks.text:
## Children Play Area
A designated outdoor or indoor play space for kids, typically found in larger gated communities.

chunks.heading: Clubhouse
chunks.text:
## Clubhouse
A shared indoor community space for residents, often used for events, indoor games, or informal gatherings.

chunks.heading: Water Supply 24x7
chunks.text:
## Water Supply 24x7
Guarantees round-the-clock piped water supply, which is not universal in all areas of Kochi — worth checking for properties without this tag if reliable water access is a priority.

chunks.heading: Covered Parking
chunks.text:
## Covered Parking
A dedicated, roofed parking spot, as opposed to open or street parking. Distinct from the general "parking" field on a listing, which just means a parking spot of some kind exists.

chunks.heading: Pet Friendly
chunks.text:
## Pet Friendly
The owner explicitly allows pets. Properties without this tag should be assumed pet-restricted unless confirmed otherwise with the owner.

chunks.heading: How do I save a property?
chunks.text:
## How do I save a property?
Click the "Save" (heart) button on any property card. Saved properties appear on your Favorites page, where you can remove them at any time.

chunks.heading: How do I schedule a property visit?
chunks.text:
## How do I schedule a property visit?
Open a property card and click "Schedule visit." Pick a date, then click "Check availability" to see open time slots for that day. Visit slots run hourly from 10:00 to 17:00, with a break between 12:00 and 14:00. Once you pick a slot, your visit is confirmed immediately.

chunks.heading: Can I book two visits for the same property at the same time?
chunks.text:
## Can I book two visits for the same property at the same time?
No. Once a time slot is booked by anyone for a property on a given date, that slot is no longer available to others. You'll see an error if you try to book a slot that was just taken.

chunks.heading: Can I cancel or reschedule a visit?
chunks.text:
## Can I cancel or reschedule a visit?
Version 1 of RentWise does not yet support cancelling or rescheduling a visit yourself. Contact the property's listed manager directly, or simply book a different available slot if you need a new time.

chunks.heading: How do I edit my profile?
chunks.text:
## How do I edit my profile?
Go to the Profile page from the navigation bar. You can update your name, phone number, and email address there. Changes save immediately.

chunks.heading: Is there a fee to use RentWise?
chunks.text:
## Is there a fee to use RentWise?
No. Browsing listings, saving favorites, scheduling visits, and using the AI search or chatbot are all free for renters.

chunks.heading: How accurate is the AI search?
chunks.text:
## How accurate is the AI search?
The RentWise assistant only recommends properties that actually exist in RentWise's database — it turns your description into search filters and runs a real search, so it will never invent a listing that doesn't exist.

chunks.heading: Kakkanad
chunks.text:
## Kakkanad
Kakkanad is Kochi's main IT hub, home to Infopark and a large working professional population. It has a good mix of modern apartments and villas, decent traffic during office hours, and is a popular choice for tech employees who want a short commute.

chunks.heading: Edapally
chunks.text:
## Edapally
Edapally is a well-connected junction area with excellent access to the metro, major hospitals, and shopping malls like Lulu Mall. It suits people who want convenience and don't mind a busier, more commercial neighborhood.

chunks.heading: Vytilla
chunks.text:
## Vytilla
Vytilla is a transport hub with strong bus and water metro connectivity, making it convenient for people commuting across the city. It's known for affordable shared and PG accommodation, popular with students and young professionals.

chunks.heading: Aluva
chunks.text:
## Aluva
Aluva sits at the northern edge of Kochi, near the airport and the Aluva metro terminus. It offers a quieter, more residential feel with riverside properties, and tends to be more affordable than central Kochi.

chunks.heading: Marine Drive / MG Road
chunks.text:
## Marine Drive / MG Road
This is the commercial heart of the city, with sea-facing apartments, premium pricing, and walking access to shops, restaurants, and offices. Best suited for those who want to be in the middle of everything and don't mind paying more for it.

chunks.heading: Kumbalangi
chunks.text:
## Kumbalangi
Kumbalangi is a quieter, semi-rural area known for its backwaters and slower pace of life. It suits people who want more space and calm, at the cost of a longer commute into central Kochi.

chunks.heading: Security deposit
chunks.text:
## Security deposit
Most properties listed on RentWise require a security deposit equivalent to two to three months' rent, payable directly to the property owner before move-in. The exact amount is set by each individual owner and is not fixed by RentWise.

chunks.heading: Notice period
chunks.text:
## Notice period
The standard notice period for vacating a rented property in Kerala is one month, unless the rental agreement between tenant and owner states otherwise. Always confirm the notice period in writing with the owner before signing.

chunks.heading: Maintenance responsibilities
chunks.text:
## Maintenance responsibilities
For unfurnished and semi-furnished properties, tenants are typically responsible for minor day-to-day maintenance (light bulbs, minor plumbing), while owners handle structural repairs. For furnished properties, owners usually cover maintenance of provided furniture and appliances. Always clarify this with the specific owner, as practices vary.

chunks.heading: Pet policy
chunks.text:
## Pet policy
Only properties explicitly tagged with the "Pet Friendly" amenity allow pets. If a property does not list this amenity, assume pets are not permitted unless you confirm otherwise directly with the owner.

chunks.heading: Rent payment
chunks.text:
## Rent payment
RentWise does not process rent payments. Rent is paid directly between tenant and property owner, typically monthly, by whatever method both parties agree on (bank transfer is most common in Kerala).

chunks.heading: Visit etiquette
chunks.text:
## Visit etiquette
Arrive on time for scheduled visits. If you cannot make a scheduled visit, it's courteous to let the property contact know as early as possible, though RentWise does not currently support in-app cancellation.
